scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build --config apps/web/vite.config.ts && esbuild apps/server/src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --packages=external --sourcemap --outdir=dist/server
scripts.format: prettier --write apps packages config test docs .github README.md package.json tsconfig.json vitest.config.ts eslint.config.js .prettierrc.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps packages config test docs .github README.md package.json tsconfig.json vitest.config.ts eslint.config.js .prettierrc.json
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run format:check
